title: bridelia retusa var. genuina
intro: Bridelia retusa var. genuina, commonly known as the Malay apple, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Bridelia retusa var. genuina include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, and fighting off infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
